Priya (People Ops): quick follow-up from today’s all-hands re: hiring + org. drop short Qs here. :wave:
Alex (CEO): fast summary: approved +18 hires over next two quarters. focus: runtime performance, Dedicated SLAs, and a few product roles.
Jordan (Eng Manager): can we get the headcount split?
Alex (CEO): rough: 8 runtime, 5 eng-sre/platform, 3 product, 2 security. flexible.
Maya (Product): are the product roles PM or PMM?
Priya (People Ops): two senior PMs, one PMM. JDs tonight.
Ken (Finance): hiring assumes steady ARR growth; significant booking changes trigger a pause.
Sam (Recruiter): reqs open tomorrow. referrals welcome (DM me resume + 1-line note).
Jordan (Eng Manager): timeline for interviews?
Priya (People Ops): sourcing starts next week; first onsites ~6 weeks. internal transfer window opens when reqs publish (7 days).
